Name: Just More Transparent Steam
Author: nolioblivisci
Description:
[size=5][color=#e69138][b][center]DESCRIPTION[/center]
[/b][/color][/size][size=3]If you've ever thought that the steam is just TOO thick, this small mod is for you. Comes with four configurations: Vanilla (100% opacity), Semi-Transparent (70%), Transparent (30%), None (0%, duh), toggleable through GMCM or through manually editing the config.json file.[/size]

[color=#e69138][size=5][b][center]INSTALLATION[/center]
[/b][/size][/color][size=3]Unzip the archive into your Mods folder, make sure that you have [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][size=3] and [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][size=3] installed. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM [/url]is heavily recommended.
[/size]

[/color][/b][/size]﻿﻿[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36010]Luny's Vanilla Swirl Body[/url] for the body retexture with [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/18yybK4t7OwtzKjJCquvcsdcuXGc_dxZk/view]Luny's Vanilla Pants Replacement[/url] (the swimsuit looks weird otherwise)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35996]DBB's Victorian Gothic Interface[/url] for the UI
